2:234.text: And those of you who die and leave wives behind them, they
for four months and ten days, then when they have fulfilled their term, there is no sin on you if they
dispose of themselves in a just and honourable manner
. And Allâh is Well-Acquainted with what you do.

2:235.text: And there is no sin on you if you make a hint of betrothal or conceal it in yourself, Allâh knows that you will remember them, but do not make a promise of contract with them in secret except that you speak an honourable saying according to the Islâmic law.
And do not consummate the marriage until the term prescribed is fulfilled. And know that Allâh knows what is in your minds, so fear Him. And know that Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Forbearing.

2:236.text: There is no sin on you, if you divorce women while yet you have not touched
them, nor appointed unto them their Mahr
(bridal-money given by the husband to his wife at the time of marriage)
, the rich according to his means, and the poor according to his means, a gift of reasonable amount is a duty on the doers of good.

2:237.text: And if you divorce them before you have touched
them, and you have appointed unto them the Mahr
(bridal-money given by the husband to his wife at the time of marriage)
agree to forego it, or he
, in whose hands is the marriage tie, agrees to forego and give her full appointed Mahr. And to forego and give
. And do not forget liberality between yourselves. Truly, Allâh is All-Seer of what you do.
